ns2:course.label: Bodies & Tech in Pop Culture
ns2:course.description: Examines gender, race, sexuality and nation as embodied in visions of science and technologies in popular culture. Topics include medicine, work, leisure, domesticity, games, films, fiction, geopolitics, and the body. Prerequisite: GWS 100 or GWS 250 or GWS 350 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: GWS 100 or GWS 250 or GWS 350 or consent of instructor.
